text: Excellent speech: Heb. A lip of excellency | lying lips: Heb. a lip of lying
a precious stone: Heb. a stone of grace
A reproof entereth more into a wise man, than an hundred stripes into a fool: Or, a reproof aweth more a wise man, then to strike a fool an hundred times
He that hath a froward heart: Heb. The froward of heart
like a medicine: Or, to a medicine
an excellent spirit: Or, a cool spirit
